title: Value of 3D preoperative planning for primary total hip arthroplasty based on artificial intelligence technology
summary: Prospective 53-patient/59-hip clinical study compares planned and postoperative implant positions/angles. Small single-center study; improved alignment is not evidence of better long-term patient outcomes.
ai_technology: AI-based 3D planning supports component sizing and placement for primary total hip arthroplasty.
organization: Orthopedic Hospital of Guangdong Province; The Third Affiliated Hospital of Southern Medical University
